One account per person; fraudulent/abusive redemptions can be denied and account terminated

steps: Go to https://www.rakuten.com and create a free account with your email (you must be 18+ and a US resident).
Install the Rakuten browser extension or the Rakuten mobile app for automatic cash-back activation.
When you want to shop online, start at Rakuten.com or the app, search for the store, and click through to it.
Complete your purchase in the same browsing session without visiting other sites or applying coupons not listed by Rakuten.
Your cash back posts to your Rakuten balance after the store confirms the purchase (timing varies; travel posts after the trip).
In Account Settings, choose how you want to be paid: PayPal, check, or gift card, and make sure your mailing address is on file.
Each quarter (February, May, August, November), Rakuten sends your payment as long as your balance is at least $5.01; smaller balances roll over.
timing: Paid quarterly (February, May, August, November) once balance reaches $5.01; smaller balances roll to the next quarter.
